Extract Comprehensive Cell-Level Properties

Source: R/02_extract_properties.R
extract_cell_properties.Rd

Computes library size, log-library size, zero fraction / detection frequency, pairwise cell correlation (on top HVGs), cell k-NN hubness, pairwise PCA distance, and outlier proportions.

Usage

extract_cell_properties(
  data,
  max_cells_cor = 1000,
  n_top_hvgs = 500,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Count matrix (features x cells).

max_cells_cor

Maximum number of cells for computing pairwise correlation (default 1000).

n_top_hvgs

Number of highly variable genes to use for correlation and PCA (default 500).

verbose

Logical, whether to print progress messages.

Value

A named list of cell-level summary vectors.

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
extract_cell_properties(example_scrna$ref)
